description: This file defines a final class 'Extension' within the AWS\CRT\Internal namespace, providing a wrapper around the AWS CRT PHP extension functions, including a constructor that checks for the extension's presence and a __call method that forwards calls to extension functions.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: A wrapper class that forwards calls to the AWS CRT PHP extension functions and checks for the extension's presence upon instantiation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Checks if the 'awscrt' PHP extension is loaded; throws a RuntimeException if not.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Forwards method calls on this object to the corresponding extension functions with provided arguments.
